notes.title: Loads of new stuff in Demo v.02!
notes.notes: Hello to all friends of Mutants Ate My Carrots! The game is progressing at a steady pace and with a lot of fun. So we present you an improved demo (v02), which we think is closer to the final result. With extra animations, extra music and sfx and improved puzzles! For the best experience and to avoid possible savepoint bugs, we suggest you start the game from the beginning! Enjoy!
